english.note: Use this broad everyday choice for ongoing care, growth, or financial support: helping something grow, or supporting or maintaining someone.

examples.english: I work two jobs to nourish my family.
examples.traditional: 我做兩份工先養得起頭家。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 loeng5 fan2 gung1 sin1 joeng5 dak1 hei2 tau4 gaa1

english.note: Use this for bringing up children or keeping and raising animals.

examples.english: My mother had to raise the three of us on her own.
examples.traditional: 我媽咪一個人養大我哋三兄妹。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maa1 mi1 jat1 go3 jan4 joeng5 daai6 ngo5 dei6 saam1 hing1 mui6
